findings.title: TLS Handshake Missing Intermediate Certificate Authority
findings.description: The web server serves leaf certificate CN=ecotechservices.tech issued by Let's Encrypt YR2, but omits intermediate certificate YR2 from the TLS handshake. Standard Python, curl, and automated HTTP clients fail with 'SSLCertVerificationError: unable to get local issuer certificate'. While desktop browsers cache intermediates via AIA, headless crawlers and API fetchers fail immediately.
findings.recommendation: Install fullchain.pem (combining leaf + YR2 intermediate) into the hosting SSL configuration instead of only cert.pem.

findings.title: Anti-Bot WAF Challenge Wall & Bot Discrimination
findings.description: InfinityFree shared hosting OpenResty reverse proxy intercepts non-whitelisted user agents with an 847-byte AES JavaScript challenge (aes.js / __test cookie) and returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot. YandexBot also receives HTTP 403.
findings.recommendation: Migrate from free shared hosting to standard shared hosting or VPS (e.g. Hostinger, Hetzner, DigitalOcean) with direct Apache/Nginx configuration and clean Cloudflare reverse proxy.

findings.title: Missing 301 Canonical Redirects for HTTP and WWW Variants
findings.description: http://ecotechservices.tech, http://www.ecotechservices.tech, and https://www.ecotechservices.tech all respond with HTTP 200 OK rather than issuing a permanent 301 redirect to https://ecotechservices.tech. While rel=canonical is present, search engines still crawl duplicate host permutations.
findings.recommendation: Add mod_rewrite rules in public/.htaccess to redirect non-HTTPS and www requests to https://ecotechservices.tech with HTTP 301.

findings.title: /blog is Indexed in Sitemap but Contains Zero Articles
findings.description: The /blog endpoint is submitted in sitemap.xml with priority 0.8 and changefreq daily, but renders a thin 'No posts yet' panel. Crawlers prioritize this page daily only to encounter zero content value.
findings.recommendation: Publish 3 cornerstone technical articles on Web Security, Cloud Architecture, and Performance, or add 'noindex, follow' to /blog until articles are drafted.

findings.title: High Template Redundancy Across 460 Programmatic Service Pages
findings.description: The 460 programmatic service x city pages share identical structural copy, FAQs, and value propositions with only token swaps ([Service], [City]). While helpful for long-tail discovery, Google's Helpful Content System evaluates thin doorway grids critically.
findings.recommendation: Enrich programmatic pages with city-specific metrics, regional project mentions, localized pricing estimates, and distinct testimonials.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Consistent single H1 per page across all core templates
Self-referencing rel=canonical implemented accurately across all 467 indexed URLs
Robots meta directives properly configured with max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1
404 error pages correctly return noindex, follow

findings.title: 379 of 460 Programmatic Titles Exceed 60 Characters
findings.description: The template 'Best [Service] Company in [City] | Ecotech Services' generates titles up to 81 characters (average 66.4 characters). 82% of all page titles truncate in SERP snippets.
findings.recommendation: Update template to '[Service] in [City] | Ecotech' which caps maximum title length at 60 characters across all 460 combinations.

findings.title: 215 of 460 Meta Descriptions Exceed 160 Characters
findings.description: Programmatic meta descriptions average 160.4 characters with peaks at 175 characters. Search snippets truncate before completing the value proposition call-to-action.
findings.recommendation: Condense template description: 'Need [Service] in [City]? Ecotech Services builds fast, secure software with fixed pricing and ongoing support. Get a free quote.' (Caps at 155 chars).

findings.recommendation: Enable OPcache and migrate to dedicated/standard VPS hosting to bring TTFB below 300ms.

findings.title: AI Search Bots Actively Blocked by WAF / Server Challenge
findings.description: Despite robots.txt permissions, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot receive HTTP 403 Forbidden, and Applebot-Extended receives an 847-byte JS challenge. Zero AI search engines can ingest or cite page content.
findings.recommendation: Migrate off InfinityFree WAF to hosting with transparent bot handling or configure Cloudflare WAF rules to allow verified AI crawlers.

findings.title: /llms.txt Returns HTTP 404 Not Found on Production
findings.description: The llms.txt standard file is unrouted in public/index.php and .htaccess forwards it to a 404 error page. AI agents requesting /llms.txt cannot discover structured site capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Add rewrite exemption in public/.htaccess or add dedicated route in public/index.php serving public/llms.txt with text/plain content type.
